title: Choreography: conditional rollback and shadow validators
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a policy orchestration layer that coordinates conditional automatic rollbacks with lightweight shadow validators. This ticket builds a compact DSL and runtime hooks that can express: (a) staged traffic attenuation schedules, (b) shadow probes that run golden-path tests without exposing users, and (c) conditional rollback predicates based on telemetry and threshold windows. Goal is to provide a safe, auditable canary lifecycle primitive for runtime-2.2.
acceptance_criteria: Policy DSL supports: step schedules, cohort selectors, attenuation coefficients, and rollback predicates
Shadow validator worker can execute 95% of golden-path checks within SLA budget and report pass/fail and latency histograms
Auto-rollback triggers when any predicate crosses configured thresholds and completes rollback within configured cooldown
Console UI surfaces policy evaluation traces, recent shadow probe failures, and the version lineage for any rollback
Integration tests for 3 rollout scenarios (fast ramp, slow ramp, A/B split) with synthetic telemetry pass in CI
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (RFC & design): finalize DSL and telemetry contract (this ticket)
Phase 2 (proto): implement policy interpreter + shadow validator binary and unit tests
Phase 3 (canary): enable on staging, run shadow probes against canary model for 72h
Phase 4 (pilot): select two internal services for live pilot with canary + auto-rollback enabled
Phase 5 (GA): ship runtime-2.2 feature flag and public docs
test_plan: End-to-end: deploy model variant A->B with policy that attenuates 10% -> 50% -> 100% and assert telemetry-based rollback at step 2
Shadow validation: inject intentional parse error in model output and verify shadow probe flags the variant without user impact
Chaos: induce increased token latency on canary worker and assert rollback predicate triggers within 2m
A/B split reproducibility: run 10,000 synthetic requests across cohorts and check distribution matches policy
telemetry_checks: Error-rate by error-class and by cohort (1m and 5m windows)
Quality regressions via evaluation set delta (>2% leads to high alert)
Shadow probe pass rate and median response time
tasks: Define minimal policy DSL grammar and operator semantics
Prototype interpreter in Go and Python SDK bindings
Implement shadow validator runner with pluggable checks
Wire telemetry signals to policy engine and implement sliding-window evaluator
Add rollout traces to Console (policy decisions, step timestamps, probe results)
Create integration tests and CI job for rollout scenarios
Write runbook for manual overrides and emergency rollback
implementation_notes: Preference for interpretable policies (no Turing-complete scripts) to make audits easy
Shadow validators run on lower-priority worker pool; budget capped to 10% of canary tokens
Rollback predicate evaluation uses multiple-leader sliding windows to avoid single-point flaps
Use prefix/KV cache hints to avoid rewarming cost for shadow probes
Policy state stored in existing release-config store with version history for audit
design_feedback: PM: prefer conservative default step sizes (5% -> 20% -> 50%) to minimize user exposure
Design: surface shadow probe failures as aggregated trend tiles rather than raw logs
Security: ensure shadow payloads strip PII and respect KMS policies

2026-02-25 - Laura (SRE): Raised concern about window sizes causing noisy rollbacks; suggested hysteresis of 2 consecutive windows
2026-03-03 - Miguel: Shadow validator PoC runs on staging for 48h; observed 1.4x CPU overhead under synthetic loads; reduced probe sampling to 5%
2026-03-10 - PM review: Approved telemetry contract with added evaluation-set delta metric
decisions: Keep DSL declarative and restrict predicates to built-in operators (latency, error-rate, eval-delta)
Shadow validators will be opt-in per rollout and limited by token budget
Auto-rollback must have cooldown and require two consecutive breach windows before action
release_notes: Introduce policy orchestration primitives: step schedules, attenuation, shadow probes, and auto-rollback predicates
Console: policy evaluation trace view and shadow probe trends
Runtime: policy interpreter with feature flag runtime-2.2
